item.text:
Reconstructed all 23 verses of **جھولے لال** in Urdu script, preserving their order, single-stanza layout, and Punjabi closing lines. Kept the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, updated the title and right-to-left metadata, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

Rendered the ambiguous “Tun” as **تُن** to preserve the recorded pronunciation. Only the selected lyric was edited, and `git diff --check` passed.
